text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! My skin is rough for 5 miles!?
Just why on earth—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mnh-mnh... Delicious~♪
You always get crazy hungry right before bed, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Gran Alegria was left
troubled by rough skin...
